title: Super Uriel
description:
Speedrun the trail of coins as you slash enemies, shield enemy fire, and avoid obstacles until you battle the Greedy Slime Monsters in this thrilling turned-based RPG style side scrolling platformer. Use your coins and experience to purchase items to aid you in your fights, as the action gets progressively more difficult.

Wishlist Today!
description_short: Keep one eye open! Super Uriel is back, and he is on a mission to defeat the Greedy Slime Monsters once and for all. Casually play and/or speedrun through 30 action packed levels. This video game is an exciting mix of platform and rpg. Prepare for ultimate game-play glory!
